events.title: FTSE 100 Slides On Oil, Bond Yields; Banks Lead Losses
events.description: The FTSE 100 fell 0.79% Wednesday as higher oil prices and bond yields pressured the index. Bank stocks declined sharply, with Standard Chartered dropping 3.6% and HSBC falling 3.2%. Pennon Group plummeted 17% after announcing a £550 million rights issue and 30% dividend cut.

events.title: CAC 40 Down Nearly 1% As Rising Oil Prices, Bond Yields Hurt Sentiment
events.description: French stocks shed ground on Wednesday as rising oil prices amid geopolitical tensions weighed on sentiment. Bond yields rose on concerns over political uncertainty in France, adding to the weak sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares Fall After RBI Rate Hike
events.description: Indian shares fell notably on Wednesday after two days of gains amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: DAX Slides As Oil Prices, Bond Yields Jump Higher
events.description: German equities declined Wednesday as oil prices and bond yields climbed higher, offsetting stronger-than-expected industrial production data. The DAX dropped 335.59 points to 25,113.60. Oil rose above $101 per barrel amid Persian Gulf tensions.

events.title: Gold Declines As Oil And Bond Yields Rise
events.description: Gold prices fell toward $4,100 an ounce on Wednesday as oil prices climbed and yields rebounded on fears Iran is stepping up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Oil Prices Rise Amid Houthi Attacks, US Storm Concerns
events.description: Oil prices were up nearly 1 percent on Wednesday as traders weighed supply risks following more attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf region.

events.title: European Shares Slide On France's Fiscal Worries
events.description: European shares drifted lower on Wednesday, with renewed Middle East tensions and France's deepening fiscal crisis keeping investors on edge.

events.title: Asian Shares Retreat Amid Middle East Concerns
events.description: Asian stocks ended broadly lower in cautious trade on Wednesday as oil prices climbed and yields rebounded on fears Iran is stepping up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: UK Lloyds House Prices Stagnate
events.description: UK house prices remained unchanged in September after falling for two straight months amid higher interest rate expectations, monthly data published by Lloyds Banking Group showed Wednesday. House prices were flat in September on a monthly basis, following a 0.3 percent fall in August and a 0.1 percent drop in July.

events.title: European Shares Likely To Open On Cautious Note Ahead Of Fed Minutes
events.description: European stocks are seen opening slightly lower on Wednesday as oil prices climbed and yields rebounded on fears Iran is stepping up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Indian Shares Drift Lower Ahead Of RBI Rate Decision
events.description: Indian shares opened lower on Wednesday after two days of gains amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is trimming early losses in mid-market moves on Wednesday in choppy trading, after alternating across the unchanged line, snapping a three-session winning streak, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling below 8,750 level, despite the positive cues from Wall Street, with weakness in iron ore miners and financial stocks partially offset by gains in gold and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Wednesday, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid persistent risks to Middle East energy flows after Iran increased the pace of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days as well as the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi forces in Yemen. Asian markets closed mostly higher on Tuesday.
